Precondition: Terminal assigned a Die Cast Machine flavor; a die is mounted
Step: Navigate to the Die Cast Entry screen
Expected Result: Screen loads showing the mounted tool, its cavities, and the current shift; Open / Record / Release tabs present

Precondition: Die Cast Entry open
Step: Inspect the header/rail information
Expected Result: Date/time + shift, machine, part number, die and cavity, good/scrap counts, and logged-in operator initials are all shown

Precondition: Mounted die with defined cavities
Step: Open a new accumulating basket for a specific cavity
Expected Result: A LOT is created for that (tool,cavity) with a printed LTT; the LOT records Die# and Cavity#

Precondition: One open basket already exists on a cavity
Step: Attempt to open a second basket on the same cavity
Expected Result: System refuses — one open basket per (tool cavity) is enforced

Precondition: An open basket exists on at least one cavity
Step: Enter the gross shot count and any scrap for the shift and submit
Expected Result: Good = gross − scrap − shot-loss is credited to the open basket(s); a production/contribution record is written with operator, machine, die, cavity, counts

Precondition: Recording shift output
Step: Enter one or more scrap reasons with quantities
Expected Result: Scrap is recorded additively as a separate metric and never decrements the basket good count

Precondition: Recording shift output
Step: Register a whole-shot loss
Expected Result: Shot loss fans out across every open cavity LOT on the tool and reduces computed good

Precondition: Commissioning/deploy checklist item
Step: Verify the die shot-count was initialized to the current physical count at commissioning
Expected Result: Die shot counter reflects the real starting shot count (deploy-day step)

Precondition: An open basket has accumulated good pieces
Step: Release the basket
Expected Result: Basket transitions Open → Good and moves to warehouse storage (first route movement); it now appears in the Trim IN queue

Precondition: An open basket below the fill target
Step: Release a basket under the soft ceiling
Expected Result: A warning is shown (5% tolerance) but release is permitted — soft ceiling never hard-blocks

Precondition: An open basket with zero good pieces
Step: Void the empty basket
Expected Result: Empty Open basket transitions to Scrap; no storage movement

Precondition: Recording output that would exceed the basket ceiling
Step: Submit output over the ceiling
Expected Result: Overflow-resolution popup offers fill+release+new-LTT or overfill; operator choice is honored

Precondition: A mounted die at a die-cast machine terminal
Step: Open a new per-cavity basket and confirm the LOT origin
Expected Result: LOT is created with LotOriginType=Manufactured at the machine, ToolId/ToolCavityId set, status Open, PieceCount 0

Precondition: A die-cast-origin LOT with tool + cavity
Step: Inspect where Tool/Cavity are stored and check a downstream LOT
Expected Result: Tool and Cavity live on Lots.Lot (never on ProductionEvent); a downstream finished-good LOT carries NULL Tool/Cavity but resolves the die via genealogy

Precondition: An open cavity basket
Step: Record shift output (the accumulate action) across two shifts
Expected Result: Each shift's net-good contribution is added to the open basket via DieCastContribution; the basket accumulates across shifts and operators until released

Precondition: A die-cast entry with an item whose route lacks a DieCast step
Step: Attempt to open/record for an ineligible item
Expected Result: Pre-record validation blocks: the item must be eligible at the cell and have a published DieCast-role route step; a clear warning is shown

Precondition: A recorded die-cast shift-output / production event
Step: Attempt to edit or delete the production event
Expected Result: ProductionEvent rows are append-only — no update or delete path; corrections are new events

Precondition: A recorded production event
Step: Inspect the production event fields
Expected Result: Event carries LotId, LocationId, TerminalLocationId, AppUserId, counts, and timestamp; Tool/Cavity are derived via the LOT, not stored on the event

Precondition: Die-cast shift-output entry with scrap
Step: Record a reject with a defect code and quantity
Expected Result: A RejectEvent is written (optional — reject is not required to record production); scrap is additive and does not decrement the basket good count

Precondition: A recorded reject event
Step: Inspect the reject event fields
Expected Result: RejectEvent carries LotId, defect code, reject quantity, scrap source, operator, terminal, and timestamp
